title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Simple and Compound Interest
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: Anil invests Rs. 22000 for 6 years in a certain scheme with 4% interest per annum, compounded half-yearly. Sunil invests in the same scheme for 5 years, and then reinvests the entire amount received at the end of 5 years for one year at 10% simple interest. If the amounts received by both at the end of 6 years are same, then the initial investment made by Sunil, in rupees, is
questions.explain:
For Anil, 4% per annum compounded half-yearly equates to a rate of 2% per 6 months for $6 \times 2 = 12$ periods. Anil's final amount is $A_1 = 22000 \times (1.02)^{12}$. 
For Sunil, investing $P$ for 5 years means $5 \times 2 = 10$ periods. His amount after 5 years is $P \times (1.02)^{10}$. 
He reinvests this at 10% simple interest for 1 year, making his final amount $A_2 = P \times (1.02)^{10} \times (1 + 0.10) = P \times (1.02)^{10} \times 1.10$. 
Setting $A_1 = A_2$ gives $22000 \times (1.02)^{12} = P \times (1.02)^{10} \times 1.10$. 
$P \times 1.10 = 22000 \times (1.02)^2 = 22000 \times 1.0404 = 22888.8$. 
$P = 22888.8 / 1.1 = 20808$.
